cards.title: All-endotactic robust permanence
cards.status: Complete internal proof candidate; root and independent audits found no gap; external correctness and priority unresolved
cards.result: Finite endotactic power-law diagram; fixed positive rate box; each positive stoichiometric class has a common compact convex absorber, uniformly across measurable rate schedules.
cards.limits: Reconstructs attributed release149 affine lemma; nonconstructive constants remain. No arbitrary unrelated kinetic orders.

cards.title: Switching and spatial transport
cards.status: Internal deduction from C01
cards.result: Common-span finite endotactic mode families permit arbitrary measurable switching and convex mixing; common convex trap is invariant under identical inter-compartment species mixing.
cards.limits: Different spans only supply initial-range safety, not a classwide common absorber. General unequal species diffusion excluded.

cards.title: Acquired exact rational reaction certificates

cards.limits: Bounded checker is not a universal efficient solver. Invariance and box-conditional entry are distinct from global absorption.

cards.limits: Integer molecular stoichiometry; exact factorial correction; stopped process only. Does not give stochastic nonexplosion, permanence or ergodicity.
